profile.headline: M.S EE, Bilingual Control Systems Software Engineer
profile.summary:
A dynamic, motivated, bilingual professional with the educational background and proven work ethic to support all aspects of controls engineering and embedded systems including software integration, embedded systems, control systems, electronic circuits design, hardware & software design and troubleshooting. Known for delivering excellent service in fast-paced environments, with the skillset to manage projects, solve complex problems, design/improve processes, support product development, and more. Proven communication, interpersonal, and planning capabilities. Out-of-the-box thinker who is comfortable working in teams or independently to ensure solutions consistently meet or exceed business goals. Exceptional academic qualifications, including a Master of Science in Electrical Engineering from Florida Atlantic University.


I look forward to meeting you!  You can reach me at (561) 699-5175 or at danielhramirezee@gmail.com!

positions.title: Software Integration Engineer
positions.description:
• Enhanced dramatically the efficiency and speed of the system model and software build processes by 5x through the development of a Python script, leveraging Excel formulas/macros, and employing batch files
• Developed system models in MATLAB-Simulink by integrating application software components models. Generated the system model controller, test harness and scheduler, to ensure efficient and optimal functionality following AUTOSAR architecture standards
• Created software builds, including test, incremental, and full builds. Compiled basic software and
application components' source code along with the RTE in order to produce executable files for
deployment in target environments
• Leveraged PREEvision software for embedded software integration and collaborated closely with component teams to ensure seamless integration of various system components and compositions

positions.title: Cubesat Satellite – ADCS System, Electrical Controls Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked within the FAU ADCS CubeSat team to model and run simulations of the CubeSat’s Controller, Actuator, Plant, Torque and Disturbances in MATLAB-Simulink. 
• Designed and Implemented a PID controller in accordance with the mission-specific requirements andconstraints. Tuned and stabilized the controller using Simulink’s built-in tools & the Aerospace simulation
library

positions.title: Electrical Engineer Intern/Interim
positions.description:
• Promoted from intern to interim job title due to exemplary performance.
• Responsible for configuring, monitoring and controlling various devices throughout the technical facilities of HBO.
• Troubleshot circuits, the wiring and tested fiber optics connectivity and functionality.
• Used Network Management Systems Evertz VistaLink PRO and modules including Frame Controllers, Multi-Image Display Processors, Downstream Keyer, and Distribution Amplifiers. 
• Implemented and ensured that all swappable Modules were mounted inside of 3RU-MultiFrames for consistency.
• Developed networking strategies including LAN connections, testing fiber optics, switches, and wireless routers.
• Managed and reviewed HBO’s inventory database using asset software to recommend operational improvements.
• Planned, scheduled and aligned work plan and resources to meet and achieve project deliverable and expectations.

projects.title: Embedded Linux Development
projects.description:
• Developed multiple programs in C with the Eclipse IDE on a BeagleBone board within a virtual machine running on Ubuntu OS
• Successfully booted Linux on the BeagleBone board from the eMMC memory, SD card, USB and serial ports. Created a minimalist root file system using Busybox and configured Buildroot to create the Linux image
• Developed a C application to detect desk vibrations using an accelerometer through I2C protocol. 
• Mapped and configured registers and created read/write API functions by accessing the Linux device files

projects.title: Vehicle Autonomous Lateral Control using a MPC
projects.description:
• Developed a Model Predictive Controller for a vehicle to autonomously perform lane-switching maneuvers in various road trajectories. The simulation/animation was done in Python
• Achieved a significant reduction in the overshoot of up to 80% compared to a PID controller
• Modeled the vehicle dynamics, derived the state-space equations, linearized and discretized the system, selected an appropriate horizon period, and computed the cost function and gradient to obtain the optimal inputs for the vehicle at each sample time
